scope: Code and offline tests only: full source General Arret plus a separately identified Python HT shutdown extension requested by the operator

profile_contract.general_only_test: Preserved restricted v4 behavior; other stages must already be OFF
profile_contract.legacy_full: All17 source event6 frames, Chroma OFF and five staged C4 stop pulses
profile_contract.extended_ht_stop: Python HT preamble first; original full event6 only after preamble success

ordered_actions: Three Chroma Focales OFF chains; source reset/configure V/slew/I before Output False and Close; then500ms
source_General_Arret_event6.source_terminal_PSP_write: Intentionally replaced with RAM software-status reporting, not an emitted PSP command
source_General_Arret_event6.source_focal_error_clear_policy: Source continues after Clear Errors; Python also attempts later stops but retains the error as PARTIAL_STOP_FAILURE
source_General_Arret_event6.Python_interrupted_start_safeguard: Restore General/RAZ C4[0]/[2] before stop; every full-stop C4 bank write keeps them released. A restore failure is retained and does not silently become success.

ordered_logic: Read fresh measured HT and explicit supply state on the NI-owner thread
If measured HT is already zero, skip every AO ramp write; never raise startup6.5 or any lower command to8
If supply is already OFF, do not ramp a residual voltage; require its fresh measured decay to zero before later stages
Otherwise lower C9[0] monotonically towards8, clamping the last step to8; read fresh HT between steps; no command increase is accepted
Dedicated alimentation HT stop from event21 if supply is ON or its state is unknown: C4[19] False,150ms,True; original EPS/DPS and100ms
Arrêt impulsion modulateur from event24: poll/stop NI6602 tasks3 and4 in order; attempt the second even when the first fails
Require a NEW post-stop observation of measured zero and supply OFF, plus successful stop calls for BOTH pulse tasks
Only then execute the complete General event6 sequence
operator_requested_HT_extension.already_zero_and_supply_OFF: No AO write and no redundant HT-supply pulse; both owned pulse tasks are still explicitly stopped before post-stop verification

HT_feedback.measured_voltage: C2NI6071E[7], /2/ai7, mean of10 raw samples, legacy calibration raw*2.44+0 kV
HT_feedback.supply_on: C4_IN_DIO96[48], /4/port6/line0, saved label Alimentation HT en marche
HT_feedback.command: C9NI6703[0], /9/ao0; logical kV to requested AO volts through existing NI6703 conversion

zero_policy.default_means: Exact finite measured zero; no guessed noise band or UI rounding

failure_policy.unverified_feedback_profile: Marche and Arret refused before output writes; operator must not treat this profile as a ready shutdown system
failure_policy.read_ramp_or_wait_failure_after_admissio: Attempt dedicated HT and pulse stops; retain all errors; do not execute later General/stage shutdown
failure_policy.HT_supply_stop_failure: Still attempt both pulse stops; no later General shutdown and no success claim
failure_policy.pulse_stop_failure: Attempt the other pulse task; no later General shutdown and no success claim
failure_policy.nonzero_stale_nonfinite_or_still_ON_feed: No OFF acceptance; timeout/fault retains NI ownership
failure_policy.full_event6_focal_or_NI_failure: Continue later source stop stages, retry uncertain pulse release, retain every failure
failure_policy.runtime_after_partial_stop: FAULT; general_stop_required remains True; ordinary deinitialize/exit blocked; retry or explicit independently verified local OFF remains required
failure_policy.normal_reads_in_runtime_FAULT: Existing runtime suspends normal telemetry reads; this change does not claim fault-state continuous monitoring

remaining_before_any_hardware_commission: Verify physical C2[7] scaling, zero/noise band and fresh read behavior against an independent measurement; default exact zero is not a calibrated tolerance.
Verify C4[48] ON/OFF polarity and behavior on loss of feedback; a saved label alone is not proof of electrical state.
Verify current Chroma COM10/11/12 mapping, OFF adapter and permitted reset/configuration effects; do not bypass its unverified-resource gate.
Qualify pulse-task Stop returns and physical pulse absence; Done before Stop or EPS OK alone is not that proof.
Review and commission the Python-specific8-kV handoff, changed phase order, discharge deadline and fault behavior before enabling feedback_verified.
A later supervised hardware test requires separate action-time consent and one NI owner; no heating or HT energization was performed or authorized by this offline verification.
